description: A boat paddled over an upward bubble column (soul sand) in a 2-deep pool and left there until the column launches it, then over a downward one (magma) until it drags the boat down and the player is thrown out.

world.note: Fabric client gametest defaults: flat world, no structures, time and weather frozen, no mob spawning

harness: Fabric client gametest: one client tick per frame, one server tick per client tick
